prose: A short antirez post titled 'Not just development, distribution of software may change as well.' Only the title was captured, so this summary rests on it alone.

On that basis: Sanfilippo extends the AI-changes-programming argument one step downstream - if building software gets radically cheaper, how software reaches users (stores, packages, SaaS) may transform too. His proposed mechanisms are unknown from the capture.
highlights: antirez: AI may change software distribution, not just development
Cheaper creation implies new delivery and discovery models
Title only; the argument's substance unknown
